entry.title: About
entry.content:
About Us

Discover our vision, mission, and the core values that drive Aspire Universal International School.

About Us

Welcome to Aspire Universal International School

Aspire Universal International School, Patna is a forward-thinking CBSE-affiliated institution dedicated to redefining education in Bihar. Established with a vision to blend Indian values with international standards, we provide a world-class learning environment that inspires every child to dream big and achieve more.

Located in the heart of Patna, our state-of-the-art campus offers a perfect balance of academic rigor, creativity, and character building. We follow the latest CBSE curriculum while incorporating global best practices to prepare students for success in the 21st century.

Holistic Development

Academic excellence with equal focus on sports, arts & life skills.

CBSE Affiliated

From Nursery to Class XII (Affiliation process in progress).

International Outlook

Global exposure through exchange programs, technology & modern pedagogy.

Our Vision

To become Patna's most respected international school by creating confident, compassionate and competent global citizens.

Our Mission

  • To provide child-centric, value-based education
  • To foster curiosity, critical thinking and creativity
  • To prepare students for leadership in a rapidly changing world

Core Values

Aspiration Integrity Respect Excellence Universal Brotherhood

entry.title: Academics
entry.content:
Academics

Explore our CBSE-affiliated curriculum designed for holistic development and 21st-century skills.

CBSE Pattern

Academic Excellence at Aspire

We follow the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) curriculum with a modern, experiential learning approach.

Pre-Primary

(Nursery to KG)

Play-way method, phonics, motor skills & joyful learning.

Primary

(Class I–V)

Strong foundation in English, Math, Science & EVS.

Middle

(Class VI–VIII)

Project-based learning & skill development.

Secondary & Senior

(IX–XII)

Science, Commerce & Humanities streams with NEP 2020 integration.

Special Programs

Beyond traditional academics, we equip our students with future-ready skills to thrive in a rapidly evolving world.

STEM Lab | Robotics | AI & Coding
Foreign Language (French/Spanish)
Life Skills & Value Education
Career Counselling & Olympiad

entry.title: Principal Message
entry.content:
The Visionary Leader

Deepak Kumar

Principal & Director

Nurturing Excellence & Integrity.

"At AUIS, we believe that education is not just about academic success, but about the holistic development of every child's potential."

At Aspire Universal International School, we believe that every child is unique and has the potential to achieve great things. Our goal is to provide a platform where they can discover their talents, explore their interests, and develop their personality.

We focus on holistic education that combines academic excellence with character building, sports, and creative arts. Our dedicated faculty works tirelessly to ensure that our students receive the best possible guidance and support.

In today's rapidly changing world, we aim to equip our students with critical thinking skills, a global mindset, and strong values that will serve them throughout their lives. We invite you to join us on this journey of learning and discovery.

Deepak Kumar Vidyarthi

Director & Principal
